skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can present the contents of strategic development and apply them appropriately to each organization.
Students can explain the essence and connotations of each strategic development document.
Students can present the process, model, and tools for building strategic development for each type of organization.
Students can explain, select, and use models and tools in analyzing and planning strategic development.
Students can assess the strategic context and propose strategic options and conditions for implementing strategies for each organization, industry, region, and locality.
Students have the skills to establish, organize, and implement strategic development.
Students have critical thinking and independent opinions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Professional Ethics and Social Responsibility Awareness
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have awareness of professional ethics and social responsibility; cultivate self-study and research habits to accumulate knowledge.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Professional Attitude and Compliance with Regulations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students know their responsibilities; have a professional attitude, respect, and strictly adhere to regulations.
